title: Straight Laced
description: Wielding a hybrid technique of weaving and macrame, Straight Laced transforms both gallery and ordinary gym equipment into a holy space — suggesting timelessness and monumental sites of ritual. Engaging greek mythology in title, Arachne Dearest suggests a shrine to individual devotion and sacrifice (highlighting micro-histories versus the more traditional heroic conquests). For instance, Arachne’s transformation into a spider after out-weaving the goddess Athena. Textile is inherently connected to stories of creation — these weightlifting "cages" carry obsessively knotted macrame designed based on volleyball charts — scoring the labor of bodies in space. By tying and knotting, I create moments that are precariously held together int he way that myths change depending on context. I distort the seriousness of myth to accommodate humor through my use of materials (like athletic socks). Adding humor and abjection to weighty references strategically undermines a seemingly authoritative installation — suggesting an anti-monument.
dimensions: Variable Gallery Dimensions: W14’ x L34’
